title: Most wanted — bounties
intro: Put a bounty on anyone from your cash. Whoever robs them successfully — or whoever they robbed and gets them busted with a report — takes every bounty as dirty money. If nobody claims it in {days} days, you get it back.

clean: 😇 There's no bounty on your head.
pick_target: 🎯 Who do you put a bounty on?
real_member: Pick a real member of the server.
self: You can't put a bounty on yourself.
amount_desc: Taken from your cash; the broker keeps 10%.

limit: ❌ You can have at most {n} open bounties at once.
placed_news: Someone put money on {target}'s head. The bounty is now **{total}** — whoever gets them takes it.
